content: Merikɨtsɨ Yawé hutarieka Kunatsi kaniutahɨawe, mɨpaɨ katinita'aitɨani:
«Kenanukukexi, kenemie Niniwe kiekari 'emɨyewatsie, keniwaretaxatɨa 'ikɨ niuki kenemɨmatitahɨawe».
Hikɨ Kunatsi kaneyani Niniwe hepa 'erietɨ, Yawé kemɨtitanɨ'a. Mɨkɨ kiekari Niniwe mɨtitewakai kwinimieme 'ekaniyeukaitɨni waɨkawa kanimariwakaitɨni.
Kaneutahani Kunatsi kiekaritsie, xeitukari kaniuyurieni mana mɨpaɨ tikuxatatɨ: «Huta tewiyari tukari 'anukayayu, Yawé kanika'unamɨkɨ 'ikɨ Niniwe kiekariyari mɨmariwe».

Hikɨ Niniwe kiekatari yuri mekatenita'eririeni Kakaɨyari, mɨkɨ mekateniyukaxatɨani memɨyuhakienikɨ, 'ukirawetsixi meta tɨɨri, hiwerika kamixayari mekananakatɨxɨani mɨpaɨ memɨtematsiɨkɨnikɨ kename mete'uhayewaxɨ 'axameteyurietɨ.
Kepauka Niniwe kiekariyaritsie ti'aitame mɨretima mɨkɨ niuki hepaɨtsita, kananakayani yu'uwenitsie, ti'aitame tuwaxayari 'amɨyewa kanatixɨna, yuhiwerietɨ kanayani meta kaniyutanaximani.
Hikɨ meta katiniuta'aita niuki mɨpɨa 'anetɨ mɨtaxatsienikɨ Niniwe kiekariyaritsie: «Ti'aitame 'aitsikaya meta 'iparewiwamete:
»Nixewitɨ tewi meta tewa, muxa yatɨni wakaxi pɨkatikwaka, mepɨkate'iyakatɨma meta mepɨkahareka.

Matsi, ti'aitame mɨpaɨ katatina'aitɨwani, yunaitɨ teɨteri yutewama meyunaitɨ mekeyuhiwerieka meta Kakaɨyari mekehahɨaweni karima. Meta mɨpaɨ katiniuta'aita yuxexuitɨ mekete'uhayewa 'axakememɨteyuriekai meta kememɨte'ayukwiwawiekai.
'Atsitepɨkatemate. Heiwatɨ Kakaɨyari tareuyehɨwirieni, heiwatɨ 'uhaxɨapieni, mɨpaɨ 'ana temɨkakwinikɨ».
Hikɨ Kakaɨyari waruxeiyaka kememɨyɨkai, tatsɨari, kememɨte'uhayewakai 'axameteyurietɨ, kaniwarutinenimayata, yapɨkatiuyuri pɨkawaruka'unaxɨ kemɨtiwarahɨawekai.
